title: eludite.debug.stop input
description: Debug > Stop Debugging (Shift+F5): end every debugging session (or, with `session`, that one) and terminate the debuggees, detach from attached processes, or end programs started without debugging.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when the solution's policy sets `debug.drive` to `prompt`; refused for agents when it sets `debug.drive` to `deny`.

session.description: The debugging session to act on (brief 0028): its `id`, from eludite.debug.sessions or `sessions` in eludite.debug.state. Default: every session (Debug > Stop Debugging, Shift+F5, ends them all); with an id, that session only. An unknown or ended id is refused with the ids of the live sessions.
